svg.title: Smart Estate – simplified wiring diagram
svg.text: Read it like this: every part gets ONE signal wire from the ESP32. A coloured flag (12V · 5V · GND) means “connect to that rail” – you never draw a long power wire.
5 V rail → ESP32 VIN, ULN2003, DFPlayer, fan
GND rail → every part (all grounds joined)
Up to 3 LEDs per pin, side by side,
DC gear motor instead? L298N / L9110S
Also add 10 kΩ gate → GND on each.
Speaker goes on SPK1 / SPK2, never on GND.
Nothing else needed: the ESP32's own
Short press / hold 1 s = two jobs.
ECHO gives 5 V: the 1 kΩ + 2 kΩ divider
brings it down to 3.3 V for the ESP32.
Then wire ECHO straight, VCC to 3V3.
Car closer than 12 cm → gate opens.
PIR OUT is already 3.3 V: wire it straight.
Motion → outdoor light 20 s; armed → alarm.
Set the PIR's time knob to minimum.
